description: This Java source file defines the DroppedOutcome class, which implements the MappingOutcome interface. It represents a specific outcome of a message mapping process where a message was dropped, and includes details such as the mapper ID and the dropped message.

classes.name: DroppedOutcome
classes.description: A class representing a 'dropped' outcome in message mapping, indicating that a message was intentionally or unintentionally dropped during processing.

methods.name: DroppedOutcome
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DroppedOutcome with a mapper ID and an optional dropped message.
